en: buildingSMART is developing a new framework, Asset Operations Handover, described as COBie's successor. Justin Kirby, writing up a Digital Construction Week talk by Skanska's head of digital construction, says COBie's rigid, spreadsheet-centric approach has increasingly led to massive data waste. It's highly effective at being written into contracts, but historically terrible at actually being used by the teams running, cleaning, and maintaining the buildings.16
